bugs.title: GLB exports spare vehicle color capacity as active instance attributes
bugs.repro: Open fresh Riverfront with the default 110 vehicles. Export > 3D city geometry. Parse the GLB JSON chunk and inspect both Vehicle enamel nodes' EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing accessors.
bugs.expected: TRANSLATION, ROTATION, SCALE and _COLOR_0 must all have the same count of 110 active instances.
bugs.actual: Both Vehicle enamel nodes have TRANSLATION=110, ROTATION=110, SCALE=110, _COLOR_0=128.
bugs.cause: Vehicle instanceColor buffers are allocated at capacity 128. The export snapshot retains that buffer; GLTFExporter exports the whole color attribute while using mesh.count for transforms.
bugs.suggestedFix: In the cloned export snapshot, trim instanceColor to mesh.count * itemSize before export, without changing the live renderer buffers. Retain the failing accessor-count assertion.
bugs.implementedFix: Trimmed cloned instanceColor buffers to active mesh.count without touching live buffers. All instancing accessor counts now agree. Actual GLTFLoader round-trip, mesh counts, and metre dimensions passed.
bugs.severityNote: The GLB violates instancing accessor consistency even though Three.js GLTFLoader tolerates and loads it. Geometry counts and dimensions pass independently.

glb.metadataNote: Per-mesh editor metadata is stripped. The final export adds root Forma extras with units, seed, dimensions, and building/road/prop IDs. Live export-root building/road/vehicle IDs were independently cross-referenced with model entities; active instance counts and loaded geometry were compared with that root.

performance.synchronizationNote: gl.finish alone returned before Chromium's GPU process completed. A one-pixel gl.readPixels barrier forces completed rendering. The synchronized measurement includes readback overhead and is not pure GPU timer-query time. CPU submission is not FPS.
